name: DelightChat

evidence.inbox: F17: Native connected email inbox on paid plans; forward the support mailbox in and reply from it
evidence.helpdesk: F10: Each customer message creates a support ticket; help-center articles shown in the widget (F21)
evidence.chat: F17: Native live chat in the store's self-service widget on published paid plans
evidence.ai: F22: AI Agent automatically answers live chat, Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp messages, set per channel

line: Ecommerce support inbox for email, website chat, and WhatsApp.

agents.math: The pricing page lists $29 a month, but the help center lists $39. Five agents are included.
The same bundle covers three people. The pricing sources disagree on whether it is $29 or $39 a month.
